featured_reviews.name: Aatmi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Panchratna Jalebi House serves a variety of fresh Gujarati farsan like jalebi, papdi, kachori, samosa, gathiya, methi bhajiya and more.

It’s best to visit in the morning when everything is hot and fresh. They also pack items for takeaway. Jalebi and papdi are a family favourite, but their samosa and kachori are also a must-try.

All items are available in Jain too.

featured_reviews.name: sameer doshi
featured_reviews.review_text: Nice place for Jalebi ghatiya and other dry snacks. Their dal kachori is freshly made and very nice if u like them sweet. The only let down is their papaya which they give with their ghatia.  Economical then other famous farsanwala's .

featured_reviews.name: Gunjan Asher
featured_reviews.review_text:
Best place for freshly made hot Jalebi fafda.
Quick and attentive service and friendly staff.
I ordered on phone and went to pick up the parcel.
Super fast even on a Sunday morning.
One of the best places in south mumbai for a typical Gujrati Farshan nasta😋
When ever I come to india and mumbai I always make it a point to have it.

featured_reviews.name: Vipul Mody
featured_reviews.review_text: Over rated place. Fafda were very thick. No kadhi. Even jalebis were thick. We told them to make jalebis thin. Yet, they were not so thin. Just the normal size jalebis.

featured_reviews.name: Divyansh Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: Just had an amazing experience at Panchratna Jalebi House in Mumbai! Their crunchy jalebi served hot with a hint of kesar (saffron). Paired it with freshly made fafda, and the combination was perfect. What I loved most was the hygiene and cleanliness of the place, making it a great option for breakfast or a quick munch in South Mumbai. The staff was friendly and welcoming, adding to the overall experience. If you're a fan of crunchy jalebi, you must give this place a try - highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Tanvi Tawde
featured_reviews.review_text: I absolutely loved their batata chivda which was freshly made. Also tried their spl chivda which is good too. Their tikhat shev is really good too and not miss their signature safed peda which tastes like a tinge of vanilla. Unique and different.  Staff and owner are nice. Will be visiting again soon to try more items.

featured_reviews.name: Vinod Rathod
featured_reviews.review_text: Ideal Mithai and Chivda is a great place to enjoy authentic Marathi flavors. I went to buy some sweets, and seeing others enjoying their thali, I decided to try it as well. The thali was delicious and truly authentic, offering a traditional Marathi taste. For just ₹120, you get a wholesome meal including bhaji, chapati, rice, pickle, and a sweet. Excellent value for money and very tasty!

featured_reviews.name: Sagar Jha
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very authentic Maharastrian cuisine and the food was perfectly spiced. Truly an ideal place for home cooked food and the place was never empty. Each puri was nice and crispy not thick in the batter like some people do it. The dry potato subzi was mildly seasoned with that hint of garlic and the curd raita went fantastically well with it all.
Must try!

featured_reviews.name: Divya Ramachandran
featured_reviews.review_text: Tried batata Vada here. It was just amazing!! Prepared in authentic maharashtrian style.

featured_reviews.name: Deepkumar Girdhar
featured_reviews.review_text: Good place to have food for fasting. There are a lot of sweets available here too. The prices are slightly higher but it justifies the quality. Seating space is good. Clean and hygienic too. Fasting food like misal, vada, thalipeeth, etc. are also available and hence make it a good place to have your breakfast. The large variety of sweets here include milk as well as non-milk varieties although both are of good quality. Staff is not that helpful as this place can be sometimes too crowded.

featured_reviews.name: Akshay Davda
featured_reviews.review_text:
Daryush Bakery founded in 1929 is a popular bakery since ages. It’s a 5 min walk from Charni Road Station.
Daryush Bakery is small, compact like most bakeries & offers bread, dry snacks, puffs, pastries, cupcakes & cakes.

Decor & Ambience is minimal & it hardly has seating capacity of 4-6 people.

Note :- Daryush is 100% Vegetarian.
They also do Vegan & Gluten free cakes (0.5 kg & 1 kg cakes on customised order).

To try a bit of everything I ordered the following items :-
1. Chocolate Truffle Cupcake - Rs 25/-
2. Mawa Cake - Decent taste but a bit dry for my liking.
3. Chocolate chip cookies - 2 cookies per pack & it cost Rs 30 /-
4. Maska Khaari - 200gm for Rs 70/-
5. Veg Puff - Rs 20/-
6. Paneer Puff - Rs 30/-

I think from my entire order other than the mawa cake which was ok, everything else was great @ Daryush Bakery.

Pros :-
1. Daryush started in 1929 & is still going strong. Kudos to the longevity shown by them.
2. Daryush offers a wide variety of stuff (breads, puffs, cupcakes, pastries & cakes) for a customer to choose from.
3. Daryush offers Good quality, decent quantity & excellent pricing.

Cons
1. Bakery is small, compact with minimal decor. ( Could definitely improve )
2. They don’t offer much seating. Max 4-6 ppl can sit at the max.
3. Cake variety can definitely increase.
4. Takeaway Bag should be given along with takeaway boxes. Please Note.

Overall I had a satisfying experience @ Daryush Bakery & frankly it doesn’t surprise me why they have stayed open for so long. Keep it up guys 👍

featured_reviews.name: Mithil Thakker
featured_reviews.review_text:
Daryush Bakery is one of the oldest gem hidden in the streets of Girgaon area in South Mumbai .
.
.
They are known for serving some amazing edible products right from pastries to Cookies to Biscuits and many more since pre-independence era of  1929
.
.
Our all time favourite snack from here is
Veg Panneer Puff which is a simple but extremely Delicious delight from this bakery served along with tangy ketchup .
.
.
Besides this they have one of the best Shrewsbury Biscuits in town & also not to forget the amazing chocolate walnut fudge which is a bit on a bitter side for all those dark chocolate lovers .
.
.
You may also indulge in their sweet Chocolate Cookies & ultra soft Chocolate Brownie to satisfy your crave for  chocolate
.
.
Pastry is one aspect where they need a slight improvement . We tried their Red Velvet Pastry which was the last price left for the day . The upper Creamy part was just too good however the lower part had got a bit dry may be as it was kept in refrigerator since afternoon .
.
.
Overall a Sweet Experience at one of our most favourite bakery in town .
.
.
Thank You for reading my detailed Review .
.
.
Mithil Deepak Thakker
